verdict.rationale: Fellow's own feature page says every conversation is searchable through a full transcript, and transcripts are diarized and timestamped. Ask Fellow and the MCP server answer questions across past meetings. However, nothing documents a unified search over transcripts, summaries and notes together, or a way to jump to the exact moment in a recording. Missing for 10: documented cross-meeting search spanning summaries and notes, click-to-timestamp playback from search results, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"
